_note: Synthetic, labelled demo set. Every till, paybill, transaction code, person, lender and organisation is invented (Example Telco, Example Bank, Revenue Authority ...). Phone numbers follow an obviously patterned 07x0000xxx scheme and are not meant to belong to anyone. M-PESA appears only as the generic product name that real confirmations carry. Never forward real SMS into the demo system.
labels: label is scam or legit; scam_type is a taxonomy Pattern name; a prediction is correct when risk medium/high <-> scam and low <-> legit
